title: Sometimes the beauty of ai game dev is having your own less than professional custom tools for your own highly specific game needs.
author: idun0
selftext:
Sorry about the bop. I was torturing myself with progressively slower versions to motivate me until I had shipped this stupid asset in my game. 

Look. I know. He had his moment. But I literally live in his neighborhood and I'm not letting him go just yet.

So yes, Jimothy is now in my little hiking sim game, "Switchback: A Tiny Hiking and Park Management Simulator" with lots of fun little interactions on iOS and Android. 

anyway, heres my entirely custom stack of asset analysis tools that have come together over about 7 months of making this little game. Most of which was created with standards in mind but made primarily for my game to optimize, analyze errors, judge movement, and to give my guy Claudeous its own tooling and vision and logs to do these things under the hood in a cheap and repeatable fashion.

Let me see your set up! Lets all get better together.

BTW - please come back and wishlist my game on steam whenever I get it on there in a day or two! Waiting on wishlist page approval still :(
